title: Design, synthesis, and activity evaluation of selective CDK9 inhibitors containing indazole fragments.
authors: Sun, Xizhe; Peng, Houlin; Li, Xiayu; Tang, Li; Ma, Xianzong; Zhong, Ye; Yang, Huali; Liu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成CDK9小分子抑制剂并评估抗结直肠癌活性，核心是蛋白-小分子药物互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Targeting the inhibition of CDK9 represents a promising therapeutic strategy for colorectal cancer. This study designed and synthesized two series (A and B) of 28 unreported compounds based on rational structural modification of the lead compound AZD5438. Among them, compound B11 exhibited comparable in vitro antiproliferative activity to AZD5438 against three colorectal cancer cell lines (HCT116, RKO, and HT-29), along with superior selectivity for CDK9 inhibition, displaying an IC(50) of 7.13 nM. The selective binding mode of B11 toward CDK9 was analyzed using molecular dynamics simulations and MM/GBSA calculations. Mechanistic studies demonstrated that B11 induces apoptosis in HCT116 cells by elevating intracellular ROS levels through suppression of anti-apoptotic protein expression and activating the caspase-3 pathway. In conclusion, compound B11 may serve as a novel selective CDK9 inhibitor worthy of further development for colorectal cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 靶向抑制CDK9代表了结直肠癌的一种有前景的治疗策略。本研究基于先导化合物AZD5438的合理结构修饰，设计并合成了两个系列（A和B）共28个未报道的化合物。其中，化合物B11在三种结直肠癌细胞系（HCT116、RKO和HT-29）中表现出与AZD5438相当的体外抗增殖活性，并且对CDK9抑制具有更优的选择性，其IC(50)为7.13 nM。通过分子动力学模拟和MM/GBSA计算分析了B11对CDK9的选择性结合模式。机制研究表明，B11通过抑制抗凋亡蛋白表达并激活caspase-3通路，提高细胞内ROS水平，从而诱导HCT116细胞凋亡。总之，化合物B11可能作为一种新型选择性CDK9抑制剂，值得进一步开发用于结直肠癌治疗。
